event.name: Break my Product
event.description:
​Real users. Real feedback. Real product insights.

​Built something and want honest feedback before your next launch?

​In this interactive session, founders, builders, designers, and creators will be paired with each other to test products, uncover blind spots, and share actionable feedback.

​Here's how it works:

​Bring a product, prototype, MVP, or side project.

​Get matched with other participants.

​Watch as they explore, test, question, and intentionally try to "break" your product.

​Receive candid feedback on usability, clarity, onboarding, positioning, and overall experience.

​Return the favor by testing someone else's product.

​Whether you're validating a new idea, refining an MVP, or preparing for launch, you'll leave with fresh perspectives and a list of improvements you can act on immediately.
